RECOVERED SNIPPET — Open Library search-inside, 2026-09-06
==========================================================
POLITICS, PEOPLE, AND POTPOURRI — L. Ian MacDonald (2009).
Internet Archive: politicspeoplepo0000macd

NOT A SCAN. The book has not been read. The passage below is the highlight window returned by
https://openlibrary.org/search/inside.json for two overlapping queries; no page image was fetched.

FOUND BY a sweep of the phrase "Camp Kanawana" against the whole Open Library book corpus, run
2026-09-06. That sweep returned EIGHT books. Seven were already held by this project. This is the
one that was not.

QUERIES RUN, in order:
  "Camp Kanawana"                                  (8 books)
  "five-day canoe trip at Camp Kanawana"           (1)
  "canoe trip at Camp Kanawana in the Lauren"      (1)

RECOVERED PASSAGE
-----------------

    "... Because she recently went on a five-day canoe trip at Camp Kanawana in the Lauren-
    tians, she is the family expert ..."

WHAT IT IS AND IS NOT. L. Ian MacDonald is a Montreal columnist and the book collects his
columns, so the piece this comes from is earlier than the 2009 imprint and its own date is not
recoverable from this window. "Recently" therefore dates the trip only as before publication.

THE CAMPER IS A PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL, A CHILD AT THE TIME, AND IS NOT IDENTIFIED HERE. Under
CLAUDE.md's rule the institutional fact is what is extracted: an outside published attestation
that Kanawana ran five-day canoe trips. The surrounding sentence is a family aside in a
newspaper column and carries nothing else about the camp.
